Reyes: Captain Reyes commands the Royal Guard at Northgate.
Captain Reyes inspects the northern gate every morning.
Captain Reyes served under the previous king before Aldric II took the throne.
Captain Reyes holds Northgate in the king's absence.
Mira: Mira tends to wounded travelers at the clinic beside the Market Square.
Mira learned herb-craft from the monks of the eastern hills.
Mira's clinic treats farmers from the eastern fields when fever spreads.
Aldric: Aldric keeps his stall open from dawn until dusk in the Market Square.
Aldric once loaned the guild treasury to rebuild the Northgate barracks.
Finn: Finn is a scout who patrols the forest edge.
Finn found large tracks near the eastern trail and warned the village.
Finn grew up in Ashvale and knows every path through the Greywood.
Finn refuses to enter the deep forest alone after dark.
Bran: Bran charges extra for quiet rooms.
Bran inherited the Silver Inn from his uncle and has run it for twelve years.
Aldric II: King Aldric II rules the kingdom of Ashvale from the capital.

Ashvale: Ashvale is a kingdom north of the Greywood Forest.
Northgate: Northgate is a fortified settlement guarded by the Royal Guard.
The northern road runs between Northgate and the Silver Inn.
Market Square: The Market Square is the commercial heart of the village.
The Merchants Guild meets weekly in the Market Square.
Silver Inn: The Silver Inn sits on the road between Northgate and the capital.
Bran is the innkeeper of the Silver Inn.
Greywood Forest: The Greywood Forest lies south of Ashvale.
A forest wyrm was spotted near the eastern trail last winter.

Royal Guard: The Royal Guard patrols the northern road and defends Northgate.
Captain Reyes commands the Royal Guard at Northgate.
Merchants Guild: The Merchants Guild settles trade disputes in the Market Square.

Wyrm Sighting: A forest wyrm was spotted near the eastern trail last winter.
Travelers report wyrm tracks the size of wagon wheels.
